note: v2 COLD OPEN (~50 s), VO beats 00-03. Same rules as SEQ_NIGHT: approved cast via lib/cast.py ONLY (guard = navy blazer), camera always moving into the scene, 2-4 s shots, readable on a phone (mean luma ~0.25-0.35 before grade; Monday morning: building lights ON), 6-frame handles, motion blur, Cycles AgX MHC. Characters: CMU walk via lib/mocap.py (hands curl automatically), poses via CA.reach/arms_down/head_turn/grip. Lanes/positions must never let bodies intersect each other or set geometry. Monday state = AFTER the heist: door wide open, boxes forced, papers on the floor.

shots.shot: Monday morning, cold grey-blue daylight in the diamond district street (S04/S23 set, dry or damp, a few lit windows). Low drone moving forward behind the GUARD walking (CMU walk) toward the Diamond Centre entrance; he enters frame from the right and leads us in.

shots.vo: Two floors beneath the diamond district of Antwerp,
shots.shot: Building section (S03 set): camera plunges from street level straight down through the cut floors to Level -2, the vault glowing.

shots.vo: a guard walks into the vault
shots.shot: FPV behind the GUARD walking down the stairwell to Level -2 (CMU walk); at the bottom the antechamber fluorescents flicker ON (2-3 stutters, then on). Grate open (Monday).

Over the GUARD's shoulder as he stops dead in the antechamber: the 3-ton door standing WIDE OPEN, the lit vault beyond with forced boxes and papers; slow push past his shoulder. He stands still (static pose, arms down, head slightly up).
Fast macro push onto the seismic sensor: a small grey sensor unit with a cable bolted on the inner face of the open door near the hinge edge; shallow focus; quick.
Vault ceiling corner: heat/motion detector (white PIR housing), light sensor, CCTV camera; quick push-up and pan across them; vault lights on.

shots.vo: And not one alarm had made a sound.
shots.shot: The GUARD's face, close, 3/4 front, slow push in; antechamber light, the open door's edge out of focus behind him; he looks from the door down into the vault.

shots.vo: A hundred and nine deposit boxes, forced open.
shots.shot: The GUARD walks slowly into the vault aisle between walls of FORCED-OPEN boxes (N10 end state), papers on the floor; camera follows behind him low, then rises to show the walls.
Floor macro dolly: emptied diamond papers (folded parcels, open), empty jewellery trays, torn envelopes, a few gold flecks; low and fast.

shots.vo: And the strangest part: the thieves had sorted through it all right here, on the floor, and left jewels and passports lying where they fell.
shots.shot: Top-down slow crane down over the SORTED piles on the vault floor (paper parcels in one pile, boxes in another, passports, a few jewels left behind); at the end the GUARD's shoes step into frame.

shots.vo: Police would call it the heist of the century.
shots.shot: Wide from inside the vault looking out: the GUARD small in the open doorway, phone to his ear (CA.reach right hand to his ear, grip), camera pulling back fast through the box aisle.

shots.vo: But this break-in didn't start that weekend. It started two years earlier
shots.shot: Building section reverse: from the vault the camera rises up through the floors to an upper-floor office that lights up; an orange line connects office and vault.
The TENANT at his office window (style frame B, approved): slow push in, he turns his head a little toward the room; afternoon sun through the blinds. Title FALSE FLOOR lands in the edit.
